candidate: G4: 5-share clips with 10-share net capacity; no additional G3 cancellation
entry: At the existing t5 window scheduler, obtain real tick and fresh book. Bid one cent below best bid, rounded down to the verified tick. Both sides eligible, no nominal cheap/favorite/RSI gate. No new directional inventory at t>=240.
inventory: Maximum net10 including same-side live/uncertain reserves; clip5. Additional same-side clips allowed within capacity. Reducing quantity never exceeds unmatched inventory; no minimum-size round-up.
reduction: Opposite-side maker quotes may reduce exposure until t290 even if historical lot cost + current quote >1. This can lock a loss; all cash, locked loss and open-order adverse-fill scenarios remain in the global $100 loss guard.
maintenance: Retain an economically permitted quote from best bid to two cents behind it. Otherwise cancel with verification, then re-quote at bid minus one cent. At most one placement per side per second, 60 placement attempts per market, cumulative $10 spend/reserve per side. Cancellation checks are not blocked by placement cooldown. Invalid account reconciliation or risk budget cancels resting quotes too. Existing t180 heavy-side maintenance retained; same-side partial orders may be canceled after t180. G3 one-cent cancellation is absent.
measurement: Actual own fills only via authenticated order/trade evidence and reconciliation; dry quotes are intents, never simulator fills. Public L2/LTP loss is explicit; no cancellation credit, price-touch fill or exact queue rank is invented.
status: Experimental engineering baseline. Parent/maker and risk-reduction behavior are supported; this precise independent quote rule and its profitability are not established. Fixed values are research choices, not fitted Bosona parameters. No live order or budget activated during preparation.
metrics: trade USD per assigned window including zero fills
worst terminal payoff including uncertain orders
net inventory and open share seconds
own parent-order fill count and partial fills
feed gaps and uncalibrated execution cases
fees: All submissions are post-only maker. No rebate credited prospectively. Trade PnL excludes fixed server costs and rebates unless separately proven.
budget_basis: New $10 loss budget anchored at the reconciled balance when operator activates; previous G1 profit remains in cumulative accounting.
budget: Fresh $100 at reconciled G4 activation, old lifetime PnL retained; G4 resumes preserve this budget.
comparison: G4 only in every eligible window, no G2/G3 assignment. Historical arms are not a randomized G4 comparator.
